selectedFunctions.label: Maseer Finance settle recorded mature CANA redemption claim
warnings: Static deployment/source/ABI metadata only; not live authorization, persistent runtime attestation, backing, liquidity, financial safety, successful execution or a complete workflow. Independent grants, policies, pauses and canonical calldata/value controls remain mandatory; zero native value required.

Only Ethereum CANA issuer financial claim ledger at immutable/nonproxy MaseerOne 0x01995a697752266d8e748738aaa3f06464b8350b; explorer Exact Match full MaseerOne and MaseerToken source/ABI. Current primary app identifies CANA isActive=true and this Ethereum address. CANA Holdings Limited is the named issuer; infrastructure affiliation is explicit, not a curator label on an already admitted vault.

Current mintable()=false and burnable()=false. Applicable market-gate proxy 0x3a0de7a4678ca9341a63ffe78041385eda65b128 resolves via impl() to MaseerGate 0x0a4c31ce6fcca5948f4abe6a7df350a88993e249. Gate open timestamps are 2025-09-16T13:00:00Z and halt timestamps 2026-07-01T00:00:00Z, with no future nextOpen/nextHalt observed. Closed mint/redeem are NOT admitted. Only normal recorded redemption-claim settlement is selected; no currently enabled ingress or full redemption workflow is represented. This market gate closure is not by itself evidence of protocol retirement, shutdown or hacked recovery.

exit(id) pays only the redeemer already recorded in redemptions[id], never msg.sender or a caller-chosen recipient. Caller must pass the configured compliance feed, but need not be recorded redeemer; triggering another mature claim cannot redirect its payout. Date must be nonzero and no later than block.timestamp. Catalog grants no compliance/KYC status or wallet authority and does not attest legal eligibility.

exit pays min(recorded outstanding USDT claim, current contract USDT balance), reduces both totalPending and recorded amount before fixed token transfer, and leaves any remainder claimable. It can return zero with no liquidity or after full payment; stored date is not deleted. No supplied price/minimum payout/deadline, no promised payout date, no cancellation and no new claim creation through this admitted method.

CANA units are 18 decimals; the purchase/payout token is Ethereum USDT 0xdac17f958d2ee523a2206206994597c13d831ec7 with 6-decimal claim units. Historical redeem burned caller CANA and fixed USDT claim at fee-adjusted oracle price, flooring amount*price/1e18, with a recorded cooldown (observed 604800 seconds). exit adds no separate fee or repricing. Dependent fee/price/compliance/market policies are not independent backing, collateral custody, valuation or legal verification.

Root dependency addresses gem/pip/act/adm/cop/flo are immutable, but external dependency contracts can be governed/upgraded; market-gate proxy current source is preserved. No independent persistent runtime attestation of every dependency is claimed. settle() moves global unreserved funds to fixed conduit rather than settling a user claim and is excluded; issuer issue/smelt, voluntary no-claim smelt, ERC20 approvals/transfers and permit are excluded. Explorer grades market-gate proxy Similar Match and current gate implementation Exact Match; no proxy exact-match claim.

notes: exit(id) pays only the redeemer already recorded in redemptions[id], never msg.sender or a caller-chosen recipient. Caller must pass the configured compliance feed, but need not be recorded redeemer; triggering another mature claim cannot redirect its payout. Date must be nonzero and no later than block.timestamp. Catalog grants no compliance/KYC status or wallet authority and does not attest legal eligibility.

exit pays min(recorded outstanding USDT claim, current contract USDT balance), reduces both totalPending and recorded amount before fixed token transfer, and leaves any remainder claimable. It can return zero with no liquidity or after full payment; stored date is not deleted. No supplied price/minimum payout/deadline, no promised payout date, no cancellation and no new claim creation through this admitted method.

CANA units are 18 decimals; the purchase/payout token is Ethereum USDT 0xdac17f958d2ee523a2206206994597c13d831ec7 with 6-decimal claim units. Historical redeem burned caller CANA and fixed USDT claim at fee-adjusted oracle price, flooring amount*price/1e18, with a recorded cooldown (observed 604800 seconds). exit adds no separate fee or repricing. Dependent fee/price/compliance/market policies are not independent backing, collateral custody, valuation or legal verification.

Root dependency addresses gem/pip/act/adm/cop/flo are immutable, but external dependency contracts can be governed/upgraded; market-gate proxy current source is preserved. No independent persistent runtime attestation of every dependency is claimed. settle() moves global unreserved funds to fixed conduit rather than settling a user claim and is excluded; issuer issue/smelt, voluntary no-claim smelt, ERC20 approvals/transfers and permit are excluded.
